modelObjects.name: ColdSearch Runtime
modelObjects.description: ColdSearch: a unified, config-driven CLI runtime that fans web search, extraction, and crawl work across overlapping provider APIs with RRF reranking, a read-through cache, JSONL audit logging, and an OpenAI-compatible ReAct agent.

modelObjects.name: User / Agent
modelObjects.caption: Operator or AI agent
modelObjects.description: Operator or AI agent driving the coldsearch CLI (usearch alias). Issues search/extract/crawl/agent/tool commands and reads JSON or pretty human output.

modelObjects.name: ColdSearch Core
modelObjects.caption: Interface-agnostic runtime
modelObjects.description: ColdSearch Core: the interface-agnostic runtime. CLI is the current entrypoint; service/API/MCP wrappers and a daemon are planned against the same core without duplicating provider logic.

modelObjects.name: CLI
modelObjects.caption: src/cli.ts - command surface
modelObjects.description: src/cli.ts - the operator-facing command surface. Commands: search, extract, crawl, agent, status, and tool list/info/call. Emits JSON or pretty human output. Supports --dry-run execution plans and --no-cache.

modelObjects.name: Execution Core
modelObjects.caption: In-process runtime
modelObjects.description: Execution Core: in-process runtime that loads config, runs fanout + RRF, owns the read-through cache, the ReAct agent, the provider-tool profile registry, and the networked tool-call substrate. LocalExecutionBackend is the seam for future remote backends.

modelObjects.name: Provider Adapters
modelObjects.caption: One module per vendor
modelObjects.description: Provider Adapters: one module per vendor normalizing provider-native responses to ColdSearch shared schemas (NormalizedResult, ExtractResult, CrawlResult). Created via the provider registry in src/providers.ts.

modelObjects.name: Planned Entrypoints
modelObjects.caption: Thin wrappers over the core
modelObjects.description: Planned Entrypoints: thin wrappers over the same ColdSearch core so provider logic is not duplicated. Not yet implemented; the remote/hybrid worker itself is Deferred.

modelObjects.name: LocalExecutionBackend
modelObjects.caption: The local execution seam
modelObjects.description: LocalExecutionBackend (src/execution/backend.ts) - the only implemented backend. Owns in-process search/extract/crawl, wraps the FanoutEngine, and applies the read-through cache (search/extract only; default provider pool only). The seam for future hybrid/remote backends.

modelObjects.name: Fanout + RRF Merge
modelObjects.caption: Parallel dispatch + rerank
modelObjects.description: FanoutEngine + RRF reranker (src/engine/fanout.ts, src/engine/reranker.ts). Dispatches the query to every provider in the capability pool in parallel (Promise.allSettled) with per-provider error isolation, then merges via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60). Also handles sequential extract/crawl failover. Owns the KeyPoolManager and UsageLogger.

modelObjects.name: Provider-Tool Profile Registry
modelObjects.caption: Native tool profiles + routing
modelObjects.description: Provider-tool profile registry (src/registry/tool-profiles.ts). Per provider-native tool: native params, common-view mappings (semanticFit direct/partial/derived), feature predicates, execution mode, output envelope, and wiring status (wired/available/deferred). Powers requirement-aware routing and the coldsearch tool list/info surface. Two registries kept in sync by a drift test.

modelObjects.name: ReAct Agent
modelObjects.caption: Multi-step research loop
modelObjects.description: ReAct search agent (src/agent/agent.ts). Multi-step research loop with structured JSON tool payloads (search/fetch/refine), max-steps guardrail, and forced synthesis on exhaustion. Uses an OpenAI-compatible LLM only (openai/groq/openrouter/cerebras/xai); never calls Anthropic. Agent fetch is SSRF-validated with DNS-rebinding-resistant address pinning (ADR 004).

modelObjects.name: Tool Call Substrate
modelObjects.caption: Networked tool call executor
modelObjects.description: Tool call substrate (src/tools/substrate.ts). Networked `coldsearch tool call <provider>.<tool>` execution over the profile registry. Validates provider + tool id, enforces HARD_EXCLUDED_TOOLS (e.g. firecrawl.agent), resolves keys, builds per-provider HTTP requests, returns raw + summary, and logs usage. Preserves raw provider detail (no lossy normalization).

modelObjects.name: Tavily Adapter
modelObjects.caption: search + extract + crawl
modelObjects.description: Tavily adapter - search, extract, crawl backed by POST /search, /extract, /crawl. Supports answer synthesis and raw content options.

modelObjects.name: Brave Adapter
modelObjects.caption: web search (SERP)
modelObjects.description: Brave adapter - web search (GET /res/v1/web/search). SERP-style with freshness and goggles; no native domain filter (lossy mapping).

modelObjects.name: Exa Adapter
modelObjects.caption: search + extract + crawl
modelObjects.description: Exa adapter - search, extract, and synthesized crawl via POST /search, /contents, /findSimilar. Neural/keyword search with a type knob spanning instant to deep-reasoning.

modelObjects.name: Serper Adapter
modelObjects.caption: Google SERP search
modelObjects.description: Serper adapter - Google SERP search (POST /search). Search-only vendor surface in ColdSearch today.

modelObjects.name: Jina Adapter
modelObjects.caption: keyless reader extract
modelObjects.description: Jina adapter - keyless Reader extraction (GET r.jina.ai/<url>) producing clean text/markdown.

modelObjects.name: Firecrawl Adapter
modelObjects.caption: search + scrape + crawl
modelObjects.description: Firecrawl adapter - search, scrape (backs ColdSearch extract), and crawl (async job). Note: Firecrawl native extract is a different structured-LLM tool, not ColdSearch extract.

modelObjects.name: SearXNG Adapter
modelObjects.caption: self-hosted metasearch
modelObjects.description: SearXNG adapter - self-hosted metasearch (GET <baseUrl>/search). Operator-configured baseUrl; keyless.

modelObjects.name: HTTP API Wrapper
modelObjects.caption: planned remote entrypoint
modelObjects.description: HTTP API wrapper (planned) - exposes the same core over HTTP so remote clients can submit search/extract/crawl/agent jobs.

modelObjects.name: MCP Server Wrapper
modelObjects.caption: planned MCP entrypoint
modelObjects.description: MCP server wrapper (planned) - exposes ColdSearch tools to MCP clients without duplicating provider logic.

modelObjects.name: Daemon / Service
modelObjects.caption: planned async job host
modelObjects.description: Daemon / service (planned) - hosts long-running and async agentic jobs, centralized secrets, retries, and job state. The full remote/hybrid worker is currently Deferred.

modelObjects.name: config.toml
modelObjects.caption: TOML config (config over code)
modelObjects.description: config.toml at ~/.config/coldsearch/config.toml (legacy fallback ~/.config/usearch/config.toml). Holds capability provider pools + strategy, per-provider key pools (doppler:/env: refs), cache policy, and the usage log path. Config over code is a core invariant.

modelObjects.name: Read-through File Cache
modelObjects.caption: search/extract result cache
modelObjects.description: Read-through file cache (~/.config/coldsearch/cache). One JSON file per entry; lazy expiry on get. search_ttl 6h, extract_ttl 24h. Applies only to the default provider pool; --providers/--single-provider and crawl bypass it. Best-effort: a cache failure never breaks a request.

modelObjects.name: JSONL Usage / Audit Log
modelObjects.caption: append-only audit surface
modelObjects.description: JSONL usage/audit log (~/.config/coldsearch/usage.jsonl). One line per provider/tool call: timestamp, provider, capability/tool, safe key ref (never the key value), success, response_time_ms, and error. Powers coldsearch status and the audit-first pillar.

modelObjects.name: Tavily API
modelObjects.caption: external search/extract/crawl
modelObjects.description: Tavily API (external) - web search, extract, crawl, plus answer/research surfaces. Paid, key-required.

modelObjects.name: Brave Search API
modelObjects.caption: external web search
modelObjects.description: Brave Search API (external) - web search plus LLM context. Paid, key-required.

modelObjects.name: Exa API
modelObjects.caption: external neural search
modelObjects.description: Exa API (external) - neural search, contents, findSimilar, and answer. Paid, key-required.

modelObjects.name: Serper API
modelObjects.caption: external Google SERP
modelObjects.description: Serper API (external) - Google SERP search. Paid, key-required.

modelObjects.name: Jina Reader API
modelObjects.caption: external keyless reader
modelObjects.description: Jina Reader API (external) - keyless URL-to-clean-text extraction at r.jina.ai.

modelObjects.name: Firecrawl API
modelObjects.caption: external scrape/crawl
modelObjects.description: Firecrawl API (external) - search, scrape, crawl (async job), map, and structured extract. Paid, key-required.

modelObjects.name: SearXNG Instance
modelObjects.caption: external self-hosted metasearch
modelObjects.description: SearXNG instance (external, self-hosted) - operator-managed metasearch at a configured baseUrl. Keyless; not assumed to be localhost.

modelObjects.name: OpenAI-compatible LLM
modelObjects.caption: external chat completions
modelObjects.description: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (external) - /chat/completions. One of OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Cerebras, or xAI. The Anthropic API is intentionally never used.

modelObjects.name: Doppler
modelObjects.caption: external secret injection
modelObjects.description: Doppler (external) - secret injection. doppler: key refs are resolved via the Doppler CLI (doppler secrets get NAME --plain), cached in-process for 5m with in-flight coalescing. Also used as `doppler run --` for whole-process env injection.

modelObjects.name: Public Web
modelObjects.caption: agent fetch targets
modelObjects.description: Public web (external) - direct fetch targets for the ReAct agent fetch tool. Validated against an SSRF deny list (private, loopback, link-local, cloud metadata) with DNS-rebinding-resistant IP pinning; redirects are not followed.
